THE_OPERAND_WAS_WRONG_IN_MY_FIRST_ANALYS.what: The predeclaration sources the per-row quantity as 'pull' from 'the nominal's existing weights npz'. That npz (pet_fullevent_nominal_weights.npz) contains NO per-row pull and NO per-row r1 -- its only per-row float array is weights_push.
THE_OPERAND_WAS_WRONG_IN_MY_FIRST_ANALYS.my_error: I first took pull := weights_push and derived that R1's CONFIRM window was arithmetically UNREACHABLE. That conclusion was correct arithmetic on the WRONG operand and would have retired a live hypothesis.
THE_OPERAND_WAS_WRONG_IN_MY_FIRST_ANALYS.the_bound_is_still_a_real_GUARD: f(w)=w/(1+w)^2 is maximised at w=1 (f=0.25) and symmetric in log w. Over the observed weights_push range [0.367695, 8.012750] the minimum attainable f is f(8.01275)=0.098643, so the ratio of any two column means of f is bounded above by 0.25/0.098643 = 2.5344. ANYONE RUNNING THIS STATISTIC ON weights_push INSTEAD OF r1 GETS A NUMBER WHOSE DYNAMIC RANGE CAPS AT 2.53x AND WOULD READ A NULL AS PHYSICS.
THE_OPERAND_WAS_WRONG_IN_MY_FIRST_ANALYS.the_correct_operand: r1 = classifier1 @ iter{niter-1} evaluated on reco, pinned to 1 off pass_reco. pull = push_{niter-2} * r1 (omnifold.py:200) is a DIFFERENT, cumulative object. The classifier head emits RAW LOGITS with w = exp(logit) (omnifold.py:475-482), so f(r1) = sigmoid(logit)*(1-sigmoid(logit)) is exactly the logistic loss curvature -- which is what 'loss curvature' means and confirms r1 as the right operand on physics, not just on availability.
THE_OPERAND_WAS_WRONG_IN_MY_FIRST_ANALYS.consequence_for_the_predeclaration: per-row r1 is NOT persisted anywhere and had to be REGENERATED by a forward pass through the step-1 checkpoint. R1 is therefore not a free numpy read; it is cheap-TF, same infrastructure as R3, and was run on the same pass and the same checkpoint.

CORRECTION_20260823_my_OI136_claim_was_w.what_was_wrong: Both receipts asserted that sys.path[0] remained a scratch dir holding no repo module names, and inferred from that that no hardcoded-root insert could shadow the imports. The premise is false.
CORRECTION_20260823_my_OI136_claim_was_w.how_it_was_found: The iteration-sweep script printed sys.path[0] AFTER importing, where the R1/R3 script printed it BEFORE. The two runs are the same in fact; only the measurement point differed. The later print read /pscratch/sd/j/josephrb/MINERvA-OmniFold/2d-unfolding.
CORRECTION_20260823_my_OI136_claim_was_w.the_actual_mechanism: extract_fullevent_fps.py:84 loops over (_HERE, _ND, _REPO + '/2d-unfolding', _REPO + '/omnifold_nn') calling sys.path.insert(0, _p), with _REPO hardcoded to /pscratch/sd/j/josephrb/MINERvA-OmniFold. omnifold_nn was already on sys.path via my PYTHONPATH so its insert was skipped by the not-in-sys.path guard, leaving 2d-unfolding at position 0. train_fullevent_nominal.py:39 and fullevent_fps_dataloader.py:60 insert hardcoded roots the same way. These are three of OI-136's 59.
CORRECTION_20260823_my_OI136_claim_was_w.why_the_RESULT_still_stands: No shadowing occurred. That 2d-unfolding directory holds 18 .py files and NONE is named omnifold, train_fullevent_nominal, extract_fullevent_fps, fullevent_fps_dataloader, diagnostic_target_override or step1_pull_push_decomposition -- checked per module by name, not assumed. Independently, the post-import digests of every repo module loaded matched local main byte-for-byte, which settles it either way.
CORRECTION_20260823_my_OI136_claim_was_w.the_lesson_and_it_is_the_one_OI136_ALREA: A path is not evidence about which file executed; the digest of the loaded module is. I substituted a path argument for the digest argument I had already made, which made the receipt claim more than it had measured. OI-136's own finding is that a parity check can be truthful about paths while the interpreter loads something else -- and I reproduced the inverse of that error in the receipt reporting it.
CORRECTION_20260823_my_OI136_claim_was_w.SCOPE_OF_THE_CORRECTION: Only the stated REASON was wrong. No measured number in either receipt changes and no verdict changes. R1 CONFIRM and R3 CONFIRM rest on the digests, which held.
CORRECTION_20260823_my_OI136_claim_was_w.instrument_added: Runs in this lane now print sys.path[0] BOTH before and after the repo imports, and enumerate every loaded module whose file lies inside a MINERvA-OmniFold checkout rather than a hand-picked four.
